mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.built_in AS builtIn, r.enabled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.role_id = r.id) AS userCount FROM sys_role r ORDER BY r.id
SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE code = #{code} AND enabled = TRUE

SELECT DISTINCT m.permission_code FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id AND r.enabled = TRUE WHERE rm.role_id IN (SELECT ur.role_id FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}) AND m.permission_code IS NOT NULL AND m.enabled = TRUE

SELECT m.menu_key AS menuKey, m.label, m.menu_group AS menuGroup FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id AND r.enabled = TRUE WHERE rm.role_id IN (SELECT ur.role_id FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}) AND m.menu_type = 'MENU' AND m.visible = TRUE AND m.enabled = TRUE GROUP BY m.id, m.menu_key, m.label, m.menu_group, m.sort ORDER BY m.sort, m.id

SELECT rs.resource, rs.scope FROM sys_role_data_scope rs JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rs.role_id AND r.enabled = TRUE WHERE rs.role_id IN (SELECT ur.role_id FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId})
INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT u.id, r.id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_role r ON r.code = u.role WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = u.id)
mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, menu_type AS menuType, menu_key AS menuKey, menu_group AS menuGroup, label, permission_code AS permissionCode, sort, visible, enabled FROM sys_menu ORDER BY sort, id
SELECT menu_id FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_role_menu (role_id, menu_id) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{menuId})
mapper.select: SELECT resource, scope FROM sys_role_data_scope WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role_data_scope (role_id, resource, scope) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{resource}, #{scope}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE scope = VALUES(scope)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
